basic_details.job_title: Bombay High Court Junior Translator and Interpreter Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bombay High Court, Aurangabad, Maharashtra, has invited applications for 10 posts of Junior Translator and Interpreter under Advt No. No. Adm/ Advt./ Jr.Trans./ 2035/ 2026. The online application is open from 25 November 2026 to 9 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: State Bank Collect online payment gateway. Last date to pay the fee: 9 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: 18 to 38 years for General, 18 to 43 years for SC/ST/OBC/SBC, 18 years to Not Applicable for High Court/ Government Employees (as on date of publication of this advertisement)

qualification.education_qualification: Degree from a recognized University in languages viz. English, Hindi, Marathi and Gujarathi.
qualification.details: Other conditions: | Must be a citizen of India Must be competent to enter into a contract Must not have more than two children born after 28/03/2006 | Desirable: | Holders of a Degree in Law from a recognized University

pattern_table.Subject: Translation from English to any two of Hindi, Marathi, Gujarathi & Konkani

exam_pattern.details: Minimum passing marks for Screening Test will be 50 Candidates passing the Screening Test alone will be eligible for appearing in Viva-voce

how_to_apply: Submit online application through the official website of the Bombay High Court.
Pay the registration fee via State Bank Collect payment link.
Take a printout of the duly filled online application and keep it for future reference.
important_instructions: Last date for online application and fee payment is 09/12/2026 before 05.00 p.m.

content_sections.text: Advt No. No. Adm/ Advt./ Jr.Trans./ 2035/ 2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Bombay High Court notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Must be a citizen of India Must be competent to enter into a contract Must not have more than two children born after 28/03/2006 Desirable: Holders of a Degree in Law from a recognized University

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Bombay High Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates convicted for an offense involving moral turpitude Candidates with criminal prosecution pending

content_sections.text: Initial probation for a period of two years

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: State Bank Collect online payment gateway. Last date to pay the fee: 9 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Birth Certificate / School Leaving Certificate / Board Certificate of 10th Std Mark-sheets and passing certificates of S.S.C., H.S.C., Graduation, Post Graduation, etc. Computer proficiency certificate Experience certificate if any Caste Certificate Domicile Certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bombay High Court Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Submit online application through the official website of the Bombay High Court. Pay the registration fee via State Bank Collect payment link. Take a printout of the duly filled online application and keep it for future reference. Apply on or before 9 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Last date for online application and fee payment is 09/12/2026 before 05.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Bombay High Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 9 December 2026. Applications opened on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Bombay High Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies for Junior Translator and Interpreter.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Bombay High Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All Candidates: Rs. 200.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 38 years for General, 18 to 43 years for SC/ST/OBC/SBC, 18 years to Not Applicable for High Court/ Government Employees (as on date of publication of this advertisement). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/SBC 43, Government Employees Not Applicable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 49100-155800 plus allowances (Pay Matrix S-18).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree from a recognized University in languages viz. English, Hindi, Marathi and Gujarathi.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a citizen of India. Must be competent to enter into a contract. Must not have more than two children born after 28/03/2006.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates convicted for an offense involving moral turpitude. Candidates with criminal prosecution pending.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening Test. Viva-Voce. Screening Test of 100 Marks for Three Hours duration. Viva-Voce of 20 Marks.
